facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - field verification of critical safeguard at SG-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on SG-3100 and TX-3001 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. SG-3100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 27 October 2015 a planned field verification of SG-3100 and TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the arc flash boundary and protective equipment not effective.
